disclaimer: This is neither the official text of the law nor a legal opinion. The document is produced by a deterministic projection (stage 2: the normative positions duty, liberty, power and immunity, interpretations and edition changes are shown explicitly; precedent positions, factor vocabularies and deadline computation policies are read in words rather than machine values; relation argument names are given by an English dictionary, and variables receive short designations by type; English carries no case forms, so the binder consumes no morphological forms of labels) of the formalization into controlled English and has no independent force: where this text and the semantics of the program diverge, the defect lies in the verbalization template, not in the program.
